name: Pin Drop
summary: A location card whose map draws itself, drops a pin and follows you along the route you pick
about: A find-us card for a bookshop café in Lahore with a map drawn in SVG: streets draw themselves, blocks fade in, trees pop up in the park and the canal flows, then the pin falls, squashes and ripples. Pick walk, bike or car and the old route wipes away while the new one draws and the minutes count. Directions sends a marker along the route as the map zooms in and follows it, then celebrates when you arrive.
how: Pick Walk, Bike or Car: the route redraws for that way of travelling and the time and distance update.
Press Directions: a marker travels the route while the map zooms in to follow it, then the pin hops and confetti flies.
Use the plus and minus buttons on the map to zoom, and tap the pin for a label.
Copy address puts the address on your clipboard; the clock button opens this week's hours with today marked.
The open or closed line uses your own clock, and the heart saves the place.
